title: Ovulation
content: Ovulation is the release of a mature egg from the ovary, typically occurring midway through the menstrual cycle (around day 14 of a 28-day cycle), triggered by a surge in Luteinizing Hormone (LH). Some individuals experience 'mittelschmerz'—a brief, mild pain on one side of the lower abdomen during ovulation. The egg survives for 12-24 hours.
